The opportunity
The transition to sustainable energy is accelerating, and HVDC technology plays a vital role in connecting large-scale offshore wind generation to power grids worldwide. To support the growing demand for offshore HVDC solutions, we have established a dedicated engineering organization focused on Automation and Control systems, including Protection & Control, SCADA, HMI, IT/OT Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Telecommunications, and Electrical Design.
We are looking for an experienced Electrical Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the delivery of some of the world's most advanced HVDC projects. In this role, you will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to develop and integrate electrical solutions across the project lifecycle, from tendering and design through installation and commissioning support.
How you´ll make an impact​
Develop and maintain electrical design documentation, including cable block diagrams, cable schedules, circuit diagrams, and related engineering documentation.
Support the integration of supplier-delivered systems into the overall HVDC solution.
Review, specify, and approve electrical design deliverables from suppliers and engineering partners.
Coordinate technical interfaces between suppliers and cross-functional project teams.
Contribute technical expertise during tendering, design, and project execution phases.
Support installation, testing, and commissioning activities, both remotely and at project sites when required.
Identify and resolve technical issues to ensure safe, high-quality, and efficient project delivery.

Your Background
A degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical education.
At least 5 years of experience in electrical design within power systems, substations, HVDC, industrial automation, or related fields.
Documented experience using E3. Series CAD for electrical design and documentation.
Knowledge of additional electrical design tools such as Engineering Base, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar software.
Experience with secondary systems design in substations, power transmission, or comparable industries.
A solid understanding of electrical equipment, low-voltage control systems, and automation applications.
Great communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in diverse, international project environments and communicate fluently in English.

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances.
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)

Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)

Join our Grid Quality team as a Power System Simulation Model Engineer and help shape the future of sustainable energy. Work on cutting-edge solutions that strengthen grids, enable renewable integration, and accelerate the energy transition—perfect for fresh graduates in Electrical, Power, or Energy Engineering.

Develop, implement, validate, and deliver simulation models to our customers in tenders and projects using various power system tools to support grid optimization and renewable integration
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including our R&D, and customers, to gather requirements to support the design of effective technical solutions.
Create software in the loop model of real-time control functions
Perform testing and validation of power system models and associated tools.
Perform RMS simulation studies with customer networks
Prepare clear and structured technical documentation and reports.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in power system modeling.
Contribute to knowledge sharing by supporting, training, and collaborating with colleagues throughout project execution.

M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with at least three years of experience in power system analysis.

Interest in or experience with programming (e.g., C++, C#, FORTRAN, DSL, Python, MATLAB), control theory, signal processing, and dynamic modelling.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently, take initiative, and solve complex problems.
Proficiency in English is required; knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.

Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.
Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.
If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.
What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.
🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.
🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.
📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.
⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.
🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.
Who You Are
✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.
✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.
✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.
✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.
✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field
✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.
Why Instabee?
🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.
🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.
🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.
💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.
🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.
Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.
About Instabee
Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.
In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

Are you an experienced Software Engineer with a background in software development and cloud technologies? We are looking for experienced developers to join our team at ICT Additude and work as consultants in assignments with our clients in Skåne.
🌟 The role
As a Software Engineer at ICT Additude, you will work as a consultant in assignments that vary depending on the client, project, and your experience. You may work with designing and developing backend systems, APIs, cloud-based solutions, integrations, databases, or system architecture.
We are also seeing AI becoming an increasingly important part of software development and our clients' technical environments. Therefore, we are particularly interested in developers who have experience working with AI technologies or who have used AI as part of their development work.
🔍⚙️ We are looking for someone with experience in

System Design & Architecture: Designing and developing stable backend systems with a focus on business logic, maintainability, and scalability.

Cloud Solutions: Working with Azure, AWS, or GCP and building or maintaining cloud-based applications.

API Development: Developing APIs and integrating systems and external services.

Database Management: Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Security & Performance: Building secure systems and working with performance optimization.

AI: Practical experience using AI technologies, services, or tools as part of software development.

🎯 The Ideal Candidate
We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer who enjoys solving technical problems and working in different environments. As a consultant, you are comfortable collaborating with different teams and stakeholders and adapting to different technical contexts and client needs.
You are also curious about developments within AI and have an interest in how AI can be used in software development and technical solutions.
👉 Requirements

University degree within the IT field.

Minimum of 5+ years of experience in software development using languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, Go, C#, or Node.js.

Experience in API development and database management (SQL and NoSQL).

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Experience working with security and authentication, such as OAuth.

Experience or practical knowledge of AI technologies and tools.

Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Willingness to work on-site with clients in Skåne and occasionally travel within the region.

🌈 Bonus Points

Experience integrating AI services or LLMs into applications.

Experience with technologies or concepts such as RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents.

Experience with machine learning models.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with microservice or serverless architecture.

Knowledge of messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

🌍 Why ICT Additude?
At ICT Additude, you’ll be part of an experienced team of consultants working within software and technology. We value knowledge-sharing and offer continuous development through regular dev-talks with your manager.
Your employment is covered by a collective agreement and includes benefits such as 30 days of holiday, ITP1 pension, a 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, and the option of a benefit bike or car.
Based in Malmö/Lund, we are part of ICT Group, a European technology group working within software, technology, and product development.
Please note that we are looking for colleagues already located in Sweden, and we will only consider applications submitted through our ATS.

The opportunity
We strive to be a world leader in electric power by helping countries achieve greener, stronger, and cleaner electricity. By bringing sustainable energy to more people, we can reduce our impact on the planet. When you work with us, you become part of a higher purpose where each department contributes. Together, we can enable the next innovation – making life better for everyone.
Your leadership, ideas, and contributions as Global Competence Manager at HVDC will be essential for strengthening our competence development across the organization. This will ensure we are prepared for future competence needs, digitalization, and life-long learning.
“Working with competence development at HVDC inspires me every day, as I get to help talented colleagues grow and thrive in an exciting industry. I feel proud knowing that the skills and competence we nurture together contribute to the future of sustainable energy.” Gia Blix, Global Competence Development Manager.
Bring your leadership, strategic mindset, and communicative style, since you will drive the execution of strategic competence development globally within HVDC. With your experience in digital learning, you will also work with and develop methods to reskill and upskill our employees.
How you’ll make an impact
Strategically drive and contribute to competence development initiatives across the organization—both those triggered by business needs and those you identify proactively.
Identify potential tools and processes to support our strategy - such as digital knowledge sharing and development of digital learnin.
Increase collaboration, create transparency and share experiences within the Hitachi Energy organization.

Maintain an overview of the competencies within HVDC and streamline competence development initiatives.
Continuously develop your area of responsibility and stay informed about future trends in learning and competence development.
Actively participate in competence-related networks both within Hitachi Energy and externally. Engage in networks relevant to our field and promote global cooperation within HVDC

Your background
You hold a university degree in behaviour science, or similar degree.
Balance stakeholders with ease with political savvy.
Experience within the field of competence development and/or strategic work.
Strong, well-developed communication, coaching and leadership skills.
As person you are organized, accurate and with a high change adaptability and strategic thinking.

Smart High Tech is transforming breakthrough graphene technology into an industrial reality.

As we move from R&D and qualification to large-scale production, we are looking for a Production Engineer to play a key role in industrialising our products and building robust manufacturing processes for future growth.
Your Mission
You will act as the technical bridge between R&D and Production, ensuring our products can be manufactured efficiently, consistently and at scale.
Your mission is to:

Industrialise new products and processes.

Establish robust manufacturing methods.

Improve yield, efficiency and process capability.

Support production scale-up and operational excellence.

This role directly impacts our ability to qualify with customers, expand production capacity and achieve commercial success.
What You Will DoIndustrialisation & NPI
Support the introduction of new products into production.

Act as the technical interface between R&D and Production.

Participate in design reviews with a Design for Manufacturability (DFM) perspective.

Coordinate validation, qualification and production readiness activities.

Process & Production Development
Develop and optimise manufacturing processes.

Define process parameters, work instructions and SOPs.

Support the implementation of production equipment and tooling.

Ensure successful transfer of processes into operations.

Data, Systems & Traceability
Support data collection, traceability and process monitoring.

Define requirements for MES and production systems.

Ensure systems support continuous improvement and operational efficiency.

Continuous Improvement
Analyse process performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Reduce scrap, cycle time and process variation.

Apply Lean principles and structured problem-solving methodologies.

Support sustainable operational improvements.

Equipment & Technical Ownership
Participate in equipment selection and implementation.

Support FAT and SAT activities.

Manage engineering changes and technical improvements.

Collaborate with Maintenance to ensure equipment reliability.

Key Interfaces
You will work closely with:

Production & Operations

R&D

Quality & Planning

Maintenance & Facility

External suppliers and partners

Who You Are
You combine strong engineering skills with a hands-on mindset and a passion for building efficient production systems.
You enjoy solving technical challenges, improving processes and working across functions to drive results.
QualificationsRequired
Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing or Production Engineering.

Experience in Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Industrialisation.

Experience supporting new product introductions and process development.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and production environments.

Experience with process validation, documentation and continuous improvement.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience from semiconductor, electronics, advanced materials, battery or other high-tech manufacturing industries.

Experience with MES, automation and data-driven manufacturing.

Knowledge of FAT, SAT and engineering change management.

Experience from scale-up or fast-growing manufacturing environments.

Swedish and/or Mandarin language skills.

Why Join Smart High Tech?
This is a role for someone who wants to build, not maintain.
You will help transform world-leading technology into industrial-scale production while working alongside leading scientists, engineers and industry experts.
Your work will directly influence how future AI infrastructure and advanced electronics are manufactured.
What Success Looks Like
Within 12 months, you have:

Successfully industrialised new products.

Established scalable and robust manufacturing processes.

Improved yield, throughput and process capability.

Contributed to the next phase of Smart High Tech's industrial growth.

The Opportunity
We strive to be world leaders in electric power by helping countries to have greener, stronger and cleaner electricity. By bringing sustainable energy to more and more people, we can reduce our impact on the planet. When you work with us, you will be part of a higher purpose where each department contributes. Together we can encourage the next innovation - to make life better for everyone.

Represent customers’ needs and success stories to drive customer-centric improvements across the company.

Keep educational, power points and self-service resources up-to-date.

Anticipate customer needs by analyzing usage patterns, engagement metrics, and feedback.

Manage and update customer information in the CRM system, ensuring data accuracy and tracking all customer interactions. Use the CRM to monitor customer health, manage tasks, and maintain a clear view of the customer lifecycle.

Qualifications 

5+ years of experience working B2B as an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Key Account Manager or Senior Customer Success Manager.

Experience with support tools and platforms like HubSpot.

Excellent presentation and organizational skills.

An innovative self leader that is service minded.

Proficiency in languages like German, and Dutch is a plus.

Experience in the field of SaaS is a requirement.

Fluency in both written and spoken English and Swedish.

A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.

Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).

An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.

A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".

Other location-specific benefits.

jobs.occupation: Fire and Auxiliary system commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that make a real impact on our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group within Hitachi Energy that develops, manufactures, and sells DC transmission systems globally. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances, via submarine cables, and to connect power systems.
The Auxiliary Commissioning team is a global team within the HVDC Construction and Commissioning division. The team consists of commissioning engineers specializing in auxiliary systems such as auxiliary power, HVAC/climate systems, fire protection, and other building services. We are a diverse, multicultural team working closely across disciplines – and we look forward to you joining us.
This is a role with extensive international travel opportunities.
In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring that fire protection systems are safely commissioned and fully operational in HVDC projects worldwide.
Your responsibilities
Commissioning of fire detection and fire protection systems
Signal interface testing of fire panels
Preparing test instructions and related documentation
Cost estimation for fire system commissioning
Collaboration with fire system suppliers and contractors

Jobbeskrivning
Company Story
 
Sigma Connectivity is a global tech house with all the resources needed to bring a product to market under one roof. We believe in investing in knowledge and education, making a positive impact on society and shaping a brighter future for all.
Through our core values, at Sigma Connectivity we create an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Our company culture promotes the freedom to explore new ideas and push the boundaries of what is possible.
Working with us means you will be working in an international environment with a diverse and inclusive atmosphere. We operate globally from 12 sites and have expert teams in North America, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, United Kingdom and Poland.
 
We are looking for a Senior System Architect!
In this role, you’ll translate client visions into robust blueprints for connected products, bridging hardware and software to define the project skeleton. As a part of the Industrialization & System Design team, you’ll own the end-to-end strategy for manufacturability, testability, and product launch—driving DFX (Design for Excellence, including DFM and DFT) directly into early PCB designs and defining test architectures from initial prototype validation through to mass production.
 
What we offer
High-Impact Engineering: Own the technical vision for complex, market-defining products from concept to high-volume manufacturing.
World-Class Team & Culture: Work alongside elite cross-functional engineers in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.
Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct access to diverse, challenging hardware and IoT projects for leading global brands.
Autonomy & Influence: High visibility and direct influence over architectural decisions, client strategies, and design-for-test practices.

Work tasks
This role focuses on the early-stage design and technical leadership of industrialization projects, ensuring that hardware and software components are optimized for production and testing.
Architecture & Strategy: Lead system architecture definitions and create comprehensive production test strategies that balance quality, yield, schedule, and cost.
Requirements Breakdown: Convert product, hardware, and quality constraints into clear specifications, including System Requirement Specifications, Production Test Requirements, and Test Implementation Specs.
DFX & Risk Management: Review hardware schematics and PCB concepts early to identify manufacturability, testability, and reliability risks, driving proactive mitigations with R&D teams.
Test Architecture Definition: Define test coverage, interfaces, embedded test functionality, fixtures, measurement methods, and factory data traceability.
Cross-Functional & Client Leadership: Drive technical discussions and balance trade-offs with customers, EMS partners, suppliers, R&D, quality, and sourcing teams.
Mentorship: Guide engineering teams on best practices in systems engineering, hardware testability, and production deployment.

We are looking for someone with
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Engineering Physics, or equivalent practical background.
Proven experience working as a System Architect guiding complex electronic or embedded products from concept to production.
Proven background in production and manufacturing engineering, with strong practical experience bridging development and mass manufacturing environments.
Solid hardware depth to evaluate schematics, drive DFT/DFM improvements, and establish production test architectures alongside EMS partners.
Fluent English communication skills to present trade-offs, draft specifications, and align stakeholders

It is meritorious if you have
Experience with connected/IoT devices, wireless protocols, or embedded systems.
Exposure to end-of-line testing, RF validation, JTAG, or factory yield optimization.
Track record supporting customer proposals, SOWs, or technical pre-studies.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Social
Intellectually curious
Respectful

 
References
Reference checks are conducted as part of the recruitment process and may include both provided and independently identified professional references.

Help shape the next chapter of hospitality technology.You build your own pipeline and know how to close a deal with five stakeholders and a procurement team. You will be selling to top-tier hotel brands around the world.

At Proposales, we're transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We're building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI.
We're now expanding beyond proposals into booking, workflows and AI-powered operations. As Senior Account Executive you'll own new business with hotel groups, luxury brands and management companies, from first outreach to signed contract. Our native two-way integration with OPERA Cloud gives you a strong story with the hotels that run it. You'll report to our Head of Sales. The role is based at our HQ in Stockholm, fully on-site.
Your mission:

Build your own pipeline through targeted outbound to hotel groups, chains and luxury brands. Expect around two-thirds of your closed deals to come from your own outreach.

Run 100+ targeted prospecting activities a week and keep 8–12 qualified opportunities moving at any time.

Own the full cycle from discovery and demo to business case, negotiation and close. Deals range from €50k to €300k ACV, with cycles of roughly four to eight months.

Multi-thread every deal across the 4–8 people involved, from C-level to GMs, Directors of Sales, Revenue, IT, Finance and Procurement.

Use a structured qualification method to keep your forecast accurate and your deals moving.

Work through security reviews, DPAs and RFPs together with our team.

Represent Proposales at industry events in Europe and our other key markets.

Share market and customer insights and learnings with product and marketing.

A bit about you:

5+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with at least 2 of those years on mid-market or enterprise accounts.

A track record of beating quota with pipeline you created yourself.

You've closed deals of €50k+ ACV with long cycles and several decision-makers and can walk us through how.

You're comfortable leading conversations with C-level executives and building a business case they sign off on.

You sell by a methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, Command of the Message or similar) and can show us how you use it in a live deal.

You use AI daily for account research, call prep and follow-up.

Hospitality tech experience (PMS, sales & catering, CRM) or a background in hotel sales is a strong plus.

Fluent English. Another European language is a plus.

You live in Stockholm, or are ready to move here, and like working from an office with your team.

What we offer:
Real ownership. We’re expanding into new markets and beyond proposals, so you’ll help shape how we sell to enterprise, not just follow a playbook.

A proven product to sell. Proposales has been recognised as a leading RFP and proposal management solution five years in a row.

Short decision lines. You’ll work closely with leadership, and your ideas turn into action quickly.

Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission on new ARR.

A personal development and wellbeing budget to invest in yourself.

A small, international, close-knit team in our Stockholm office, with an annual meetup and regular team activities.

What we believe in:
We value ownership over process, curiosity over comfort and getting things done over getting them perfect.

Luleå University of Technology experiences rapid growth with world-leading expertise within several research areas. Our scientific and artistic research and education are conducted in close collaboration with international, national and regional companies, the public sector and leading universities. Luleå University of Technology has an annual turnover of just over SEK 2.3 billion. We have more than 1,800 employees and nearly 21,600 students.
The Machine Learning group at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for experienced students from the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme for a project focusing student retention through the mentoring and support of first year students in the programme.
 
 
You will have the opportunity to work together with other mentors and keep in contact with some senior staff, while getting the opportunity to:
Meet new people and refresh information from earlier courses
Improve your communication- and social skills
Gain leadership/mentoring experience

Job Duties
 
Typical job duties for this position will focus on tasks related to leadership and mentoring:
Organizing regular meetings with the mentee-group assigned to you, where you discuss their current challenges and questions
Having some hours set aside on a weekly basis in case one of your mentees would like to have an individual meeting/discussion
Advising students on who they can help/advise them in certain situations (if you cannot do so yourself)
Keeping in regular touch both with the mentees and other mentors

Qualifications
 
To be eligible for the position, you must be enrolled as a student in the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme of LTU. You must be in at least your second year of study and have some experience in mentoring (e.g. having had earlier meetings with the 1st year students during the first study period of the year). You are also expected to be able to take your own initiative and work independently.
 
 
It is a merit to have contributed to the programme in some capacity before (e.g. as student representative, member in Programme Council, having a role in the program association).
 
 
Terms and conditions
 
Employment as a teaching assistant is governed by Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance. Only those admitted to first- or second-cycle studies may be employed as teaching assistants (Chapter 5, Section 10 of the Higher Education Ordinance).
 
 
Hourly pay/renumeration
 
All assignments provide hourly pay and valuable work experience for your CV. The hourly rate depends on the complexity of the duties:
Level 1: 156 kr/hour 
Level 2: 171 kr/hour  
 
 
Information
 
The position is 10% full-time, corresponding to an average of a half day/week over a period of 6 months from December 2026  to June 2027 or as agreed. The place of work is Luleå.
The workload may vary over time and by agreement. The goal is to distribute the work so that it is compatible with your studies.

Ensure seamless interaction between electrical systems, electronics, and control systems.

We believe you are relatively early in your career but already demonstrate a strong technical drive and ability to take ownership. You enjoy working where hardware, software, and electrical systems meet, and you are motivated by solving complex technical challenges together with experienced colleagues.

A few years of experience working at the interface between electrical systems, electronics, software, or embedded systems 
Solid understanding of PCB development, control boards, and control systems 
Comfortable working across both hardware and software domains, with the ability to understand how the two interact in a complete product 
An eagerness to learn and grow technically, combined with a senior mindset and the confidence to challenge solutions and contribute to technical discussions 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines

Master’s degree in ex. Electrical Engineering /Electronics/Embedded Systems, Mechatronics/Engineering Physics/Mechanical Engineering.
